p.title: v59.97 the 10-year direction word was chosen from FRED DGS10 while the sentence printed the market ^TNX change
p.symptom: 시장 이야기 and the 매크로 금리 장 printed the ^TNX 10-year change but read flat or moved, and the direction, from the FRED DGS10 change: on 2026-10-23 '10년 5.10 → 4.99% (-11bp) … 큰 변화가 없습니다'. Replay of the last 120 published sessions: 6 days in 시장 이야기 and 1 in the 매크로 rates chapter where a printed move of 10bp or more read flat, plus 1 매크로 day where a printed move under 10bp read as moved.
p.root_cause: v59.70 switched the printed 10-year to the market close series but left ratesOf (market-story.js) and the 매크로 rates chapter (macro-chapters.js) deciding the kind from the FRED total, so the sentence and its number came from two sources.
p.fix: Both functions decide flat vs moved and the direction from the printed span (market ^TNX when present, else FRED). The real/breakeven shares still split the FRED total and are read only when that total moved 10bp or more the same way; otherwise a new 'undivided' kind reads '실질금리·기대인플레로 나눠 읽을 수 없습니다'.
p.violated_rule: A sentence takes its threshold and its source from the module that prints the number.
p.prevention: esm-core unit assertions through buildMarketStory and buildMacroChapters: ^TNX +11bp with FRED +8bp is not flat and claims no split; ^TNX +11 with FRED -12 never reads as a fall; ^TNX +8 with FRED +11 reads flat; both +12 with a real share of 0.75 keep the real-up reading.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-esm-core-unit-check.mjs (new assertions fail on the old source); replay of the last 120 sessions of public-data/history.json and macro-history.json: printed >= 10bp read flat 6 -> 0 (story) and 1 -> 0 (매크로), printed < 10bp read moved 0 -> 0 and 1 -> 0; ci-metric-consistency-check, ci-crash-replay-check, ci-scenario-guidance-fixture, ci-pipeline-semantics-check exit 0 with no edited expectation.

changelog: **10-year direction follows the printed series ({P}):** 시장 이야기 and the 매크로 금리 장 now read flat or moved, and the direction, from the 10-year change they print (^TNX) instead of FRED DGS10; when the FRED legs disagree with the printed move the sentence says the move cannot be split into real yield and breakeven.
note: v59.97: 10-year direction follows the printed series
